scope: Local connector orientation diagnostics; not production acceptance
methods: Fetched C599441 and C3096093 public catalog CAD through original jlc_twin.fetch, one attempt each.
Compared every numbered connector pad using original jlc_twin.best_fit over quarter-turns and mirror candidates.
Checked all 18 RJ locator holes independently of the numbered-pad fit.
Installed only catalog connector models into diagnostic copies using original twin model-transform formula, without moving native footprints or pads.
Rendered diagnostic copies with KiCad native renderer from top and opposing 45-degree views.
Compared mouth direction with retained Amphenol and Same Sky mechanical drawings.

findings.RJ_carrier_J101_J108_and_pod_J1: Catalog-to-native local pad-fit rotation 180 degrees; maximum numbered-pad residual 0.014 mm and locator residual 0.004 mm. Fitted model openings face the connector edge, agreeing with manufacturer-derived native direction.
findings.power_carrier_J1: Catalog-to-native local pad-fit rotation 180 degrees, combined with native footprint rotation 180 degrees. Maximum rounded-fit pad residual below 0.001 mm. Fitted model opening faces outward.
findings.previous_render_limitation: Drawing-derived solids demonstrate declared geometry, not an independent catalog-model registration check.
findings.hypothesis: A catalog/native orientation convention difference may explain the inward JLC previews. This is not a verified diagnosis of the actual JLC drafts.

remaining_holds: Capture and compare actual JLC numbered-pin, hole, peg and mouth registration; public catalog CAD alone does not establish draft model or CPL convention.
No complete P-ORIENT/P-MATE-REG acceptance, signed-side/body census or plug-fit approval was performed.
Pico USB/module and other component bodies are not included in these focused connector renders.
No native board, CPL, quote package or JLC draft changes are authorized by these diagnostics.
